title: Gemma: Open Models Based on Gemini Research and Technology
before: Google published research and shipped products, but released no competitive open weights.
problem: The open ecosystem was consolidating around Meta and Mistral.
breakthrough: Small open models built from the Gemini work, under Google's own use-restricted terms.
why: It brought the third major lab into open weights and intensified the small-model competition.
next: Gemma 2 and 3, and continued pressure at the small end.
inherits: Frontier labs releasing small open models alongside closed flagships.
